title: Snapshots, exactly-once clients and linearizable reads
brief:
## What you'll build

Turn your replicated KV store into one you could actually operate. Add **snapshots** with `InstallSnapshot` so the log stays bounded, **client sessions** so retried writes apply exactly once, and **linearizable reads** using ReadIndex. As a stretch goal, add **single-server membership changes**.

## Why

Without compaction, memory and restart time grow without bound. Without deduplication, a leader crash between commit and reply makes clients double-apply writes. Without a leadership check on reads, a deposed leader serves stale data. These are the gaps between textbook Raft and a service people can depend on.

## Constraints

- Suggested language: **Go**, extending projects 1 to 3.
- The KV server snapshots when the persisted Raft state exceeds a configurable `maxRaftState` bytes.
- The snapshot includes the KV map **and** the client session table.
- All log access goes through index-translation helpers that account for `lastIncludedIndex`.
- Persist Raft state and snapshot together, atomically.
- Reads must not go through the log; use ReadIndex (leases optional, behind a flag).
- Membership changes (stretch): one server at a time, and only after the leader has committed an entry in its current term.

starter.note: Snapshot(index, state), the InstallSnapshot RPC types and handler, and index translation helpers that use lastIncludedIndex.
Client ID and sequence number handling: the per-client (lastSeq, lastResult) table consulted during apply.
A Clerk that remembers the last known leader, generates a unique client ID, and retries with the same sequence number until it gets an answer.
ReadIndex: wait for the current-term no-op to commit, record commitIndex, confirm leadership with a heartbeat round, wait for lastApplied.
Stretch: AddServer/RemoveServer appending a configuration entry, and using the latest configuration in the log for majorities.

hints: Do snapshots first, and start by making every existing project 3 test pass with log indices offset by a nonzero lastIncludedIndex, before writing InstallSnapshot at all.
When the leader's nextIndex for a follower is at or below lastIncludedIndex, send InstallSnapshot instead of AppendEntries; after it succeeds set nextIndex to lastIncludedIndex + 1.
In the InstallSnapshot handler, ignore snapshots older than the one you have, and keep log entries after lastIncludedIndex if the entry there matches the snapshot's term.

The apply loop must handle two kinds of messages, commands and snapshots, and a snapshot must reset lastApplied. Make sure an in-flight command for an older index is not applied after a newer snapshot.
For dedup, store the cached result alongside lastSeq. A retried Get or Append must return the original answer, not recompute it from the current state.

rubric.criterion: Log stays bounded under load; InstallSnapshot brings a far-behind follower up to date
Snapshot includes lastIncludedIndex/Term, the KV map and the session table, persisted atomically with Raft state
Retried client requests are applied exactly once across leader crashes
Reads are linearizable via ReadIndex and never served by a deposed leader

milestones.title: Snapshots
milestones.body: Implement Snapshot and InstallSnapshot. Run a workload large enough to trigger many snapshots, crash and restart servers, and disconnect one follower long enough that it needs a snapshot to catch up. **Done when** the persisted Raft state never exceeds 8 × maxRaftState and all servers converge.

milestones.title: Exactly-once clients
milestones.body: Add client IDs and sequence numbers. The tester drops replies and crashes leaders between commit and reply. **Done when** every Append appears exactly once in the final values.

milestones.title: Linearizable reads
milestones.body: Implement ReadIndex. Partition the leader into a minority and confirm it refuses (or never answers) reads, while the majority side serves fresh values. A linearizability checker (such as Porcupine) validates the client history. **Done when** the checker accepts every run.

milestones.title: Stretch: membership changes
milestones.body: Implement AddServer and RemoveServer one server at a time, with new servers joining as learners until caught up. Grow a cluster from 3 to 5 and shrink it back while clients run. **Done when** no two leaders ever share a term and all committed writes survive.
